explication: Cacti is a network monitoring and graphing platform. Its principal workflow is: an operator authenticates through the web interface, configures devices and reusable templates, polling collects measurements from devices or scripts, time-series data is stored, and graph views or exports present the result. Automation, remote collection, RBAC, plugins, reports, and notifications are additional product branches. The map relies on README capabilities, the repository tree, and sampled files; several unsampled subsystem links are therefore intentionally conservative.
